versions.changelog:
## Added
- The supported model table now lists claude-sonnet-5-5, served through Anthropic Messages, as the Sonnet 5 successor for everyday coding and agents.
- The supported model table now lists claude-haiku-5-5, served through Anthropic Messages, as the lowest-cost Claude model with higher rates above 100K-token prompts.

## Changed
- The supported model table now describes claude-opus-5-5 as the Claude model for long-running agentic coding and knowledge work.

## Added
- claude-opus-5-5 is listed among the supported Claude models and accepts Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses, and Gemini contents like the other current Claude models.

## Added
- Add claude-fable-5-1 to the supported model list.

## Changed
- Document Claude authentication, request, result verification, and stop boundaries in the primary recipe, with compatibility protocols loaded only when required.

## Changed
- Complete marketplace distribution for the RunAPI Claude skill.

## Added
- List claude-opus-5 in the model table so the skill surfaces the latest Opus tier.

## Changed
- Remove the retired Claude 4 launch model IDs from the supported-model tables.
- Keep the currently serviceable Claude model roster unchanged.

## Changed
- Publish the Claude skill v0.2.10 release with refreshed RunAPI routing metadata.

## Changed
- Supported models table is now generated from the RunAPI catalog (the `/v1/models` source of truth).
- Added `claude-fable-5` and the dated Claude 4 / 4.1 snapshots that are currently callable.

## Changed
- Clarify Claude protocol compatibility across Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible, and Gemini contents clients.
